about.title: About Baafiye
about.intro: Baafiye is a platform that helps the Mogadishu community recover lost belongings by connecting the person who found an item with the person who owns it.
about.whatTitle: A simple way for people to get their items back.
about.whatP1: Losing something important can be stressful. Finding something that belongs to someone else can also be hard.
about.whatP2: Baafiye is one place where you can post an item you found, report an item you lost, or search listings that have already been posted.
about.findBody: Search found items or items someone else has lost.
about.returnBody: Help someone get back what they own.
about.communityBody: Connect people without using in-app chat.
about.trustBody: Phone numbers stay hidden until someone chooses to make contact. We do not ask for secrets.
about.step1Body: Post an item you found, or an item you lost.
about.step2Body: Search by name, category, or district.
about.step3Body: Reveal the number, call, and confirm it is the right item. Do not exchange money.
about.missionBody: To make recovering belongings simple and open to the community, without sharing private details.
about.closeBody: A small honest action can mean a great deal to someone else.

services.title: How Baafiye helps you
services.body: Search, post, call. There is no in-app chat and no claim process.

services.ctaBody: Every returned item is different. Join Baafiye and help your neighbors.
